== Summary ==
Identified: [[Tamás Papp]] (navy sweater over a blue shirt), [[Cedrik Vanderhaegen]] (light-blue hoodie), [[Lynden Pater]] (glasses), and [[Kevin Jaap]] (black McLaren tee with a yellow 4, glasses; same face as [[:File:Kevin Jaap 2024 Hall of Fame.jpg]]). The man in the black shirt next to Kevin is the same person as the black jacket in [[:File:2023 Naboo Regionals 8.jpg]] and [[:File:2023 Naboo Regionals quiz 1.jpg]], and is not named. Other diners further along the table are not all named from this frame.

Closing meal at the 2023 Naboo Regionals ("Foil Fest") weekend in Liverpool, UK, 3 June 2023, hosted by Team Wales.

* '''Event:''' [[2023 Regional Championships]]
* '''Date:''' 3 June 2023
* '''Date posted:''' 2023-06-04
* '''Identification:''' [[Tamás Papp]] (navy sweater over a blue shirt), [[Cedrik Vanderhaegen]] (light-blue hoodie), [[Lynden Pater]] (glasses), and [[Kevin Jaap]] (black McLaren tee with a yellow 4, glasses; same face as [[:File:Kevin Jaap 2024 Hall of Fame.jpg]]). The man in the black shirt next to Kevin is the same person as the black jacket in [[:File:2023 Naboo Regionals 8.jpg]] and [[:File:2023 Naboo Regionals quiz 1.jpg]], and is not named. Other diners further along the table are not all named from this frame.
